subject: UPDATED: PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI FOR THURSDAY, JUNE 11, 2026
plaintextBody:
City Seal 170

June 11, 2026  

*FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY*   

*CONTACT:* pressoffice@cityhall.nyc.gov    

  

  

*UPDATED: PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI*    

*FOR THURSDAY, JUNE 11, 2026*   

    

"On Thursday, Mayor Mamdani will host “The Morning Pitch” to provide traffic and weather updates ahead of the World Cup. This event will be streamed live on ""YouTube" [ https://www.youtube.com/nycmayorsoffice?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""Instagram" [ https://instagram.com/nycmayor/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""Facebook" [ https://facebook.com/NYCMayor/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""X" [ https://x.com/NYCMayor?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]" and available on Encompass Port CTY-3653."   

   

"Then, the Mayor will appear on HOT 97 Mornings with Mero (97.1 FM)."  

 

"After, the Mayor will visit a restaurant in the Bronx to watch Mexico and South Africa kick off the 2026 FIFA World Cup™. This event is open to invited press." 

   

"Later, the Mayor will meet with families and children to promote 2-K applications. This event is open to invited press."   

   

_*Press Schedule*_:" "    

   

*9:15 AM – Hosts “The Morning Pitch” to Provide Traffic and Weather Updates Ahead of World Cup *   

"This event will be streamed live on ""YouTube" [ https://www.youtube.com/nycmayorsoffice?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""Instagram" [ https://instagram.com/nycmayor/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""Facebook" [ https://facebook.com/NYCMayor/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""X" [ https://x.com/NYCMayor?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]" and available on Encompass Port CTY-3653."   

   

*9:35 AM (Approx.) – Appears on HOT 97 Mornings with Mero (97.1 FM)*  

 

*3:00 PM – Visits Restaurant in the Bronx to Watch Mexico and South Africa Kick Off 2026 FIFA World Cup**"™"* 

"This event is open to invited press." 

  

*4:45 PM – Meets with Families and Children to Promote 2-K Applications*   

"This event is open to invited press."  

  

Photos will be available here [ https://www.flickr.com/photos/nycmayorsoffice/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ].
